Week One Meal Prep
THE NIGHT BEFORE DAY 1
 * Make 3 Cherry Pie Fridge Oats. (Reminder: All the recipes in the Jumpstart are for one
 serving for one person, so you’ll make three full recipes to prep three servings.)
 * Make 7 hard-boiled eggs if using an egg as your dinner protein. (See the next page!)
 * Make 3 Roasted Veggie Power Bowls.
 * Prep the strawberries and sweet potatoes for 2 days of Street Tacos and prep the bell
 pepper and grate the cheese for 1 day of Pita Pizza Party. (Prep just means to cut them so
 they’re quicker to use later!)




 a

 a

 * Make 4 Roasted Veggie Power Bowls. (It’s not recommended to eat leftovers longer than
 4 days for food contamination reasons so don’t do all 7 at once.)

 pepper and grate the cheese for 2 days of Pita Pizza Party.

mealPrepText:
THE NIGHT BEFORE DAY 1

- Make 3 Carrot Cake Overnight Oats. Reminder: all the recipes (except the chili
and ratatouille) in this meal plan are for one serving, so you will triple the recipe to

prep 3 servings.

- Prep turkey patties for 4 days of Brunch Sandwiches. If you are using hard-boiled
eggs for this recipe, prep 4. You also have the option to cook a fresh egg any way you
want it with this sandwich, but if you're packing this lunch, hard-boiled ts the way to
go! If you're packing this lunch you don’t need to toast the bread, you can slice your
bread from the loaf the morning of Consider slicing and freezing the loaf after a
couple days to keep tt fresher as you will need one slice each day. Another option is to
simply use sandwich bread, as bakery loaves tend to go stale more quickly. (If you
chose a fruit side that can be prepped/sliced in advance, prep 4 fruit servings as well.)
- Prep 4 Veggie Fried Quinoa dinners. NOTE: Only prep the eggs if you are doing
4 hard-boiled. If you are choosing to add a fresh egg at dinner time then just
skip the egg part and prepare it just before serving
THE NIGHT OF DAY 3
- Make 1 Carrot Cake Overnight Oats.

THE NIGHT OF DAY 4
- Make 3 servings of Brunch Bites. You will need to add the avocado/microgreens
the day of, so no need to prep the toppings. If you are bringing it to work you can
squeeze lemon juice over the avocado to keep it fresh.

- Prep turkey patties for 3 days of Brunch Sandwiches. If using hard-boiled eggs,

prep 3. If applicable, prep 3 servings of your fruit side.

- Make 3 cauliflower crusts for Hello Hawaii Za. You can refrigerate or freeze
these. Prep 3 servings of the pineapple, onion, and bacon. This recipe allows for an
additional 100 calorie side; refer to Week 1 Grocery List and recipe for more details

and include that in your prep if applicable.
